column1: You nervously struggle with the rope...Finally you loosen her bonds and set her free.
column2: 你緊張地解著繩子……終於鬆開她的束縛，讓她重獲自由。

column1: She whispers in your ear about how happy she is to see you. Then...
column2: 她在你耳邊低語，說見到你有多麼高興。接著……

column1: She smothers you in her lipstick.
column2: 她用口紅把你親得滿臉都是。

column1: Marie is very nervous and excited. Crying loudly, she tells you how happy she is to see you. Then...
column2: 瑪麗又緊張又興奮。她放聲哭著告訴你見到你有多麼高興。接著……

column1: All of a sudden Bains appears in the control room...
column2: 班恩斯突然出現在控制室……

column1: Nervous and trying to stay as quiet as possible, Marie whispers...
column2: 瑪麗緊張地想盡量保持安靜，低聲說道……

column1: Please, S-S-Sonny, let's g-get out of here b-before h-he comes b-back.
column2: 「拜託，桑、桑、桑尼，我們趕、趕快離開這裡，趁、趁他還沒回來。」

column1: Bains has the drop on you as he says......
column2: 班恩斯佔了先機，對你說……

column1: I have you right where I want you, PIG EYES!!
column2: 「你正好落在我想要的位置，豬眼睛！！」

column1: You're just in time to see the fire from Bains' gun.
column2: 你只能及時看見班恩斯槍口的火光。

column1: In Marie's excited state of being, she raised her voice, alerting Bains. Next time try to calm her before untying her.
column2: 瑪麗情緒太過激動，提高了音量，驚動班恩斯。下次替她解綁前，先試著讓她冷靜下來。

column1: The sound of approaching footsteps interrupts your plans, and Marie says...
column2: 逐漸接近的腳步聲打斷了你的計畫，瑪麗說道……

column1: OH MY GOD!!! He's coming back!
column2: 「我的天啊！！！他回來了！」

column1: Continuing she says,"Sonny! You must hide."
column2: 她接著說：「桑尼！你一定要躲起來。」

column1: One loaded gun in your hand is worth two in the holster.
column2: 手中一把上膛的槍，勝過槍套裡的兩把槍。

column1: Standing out in the open, you shoot it out with Bains. Your nervousness causes you to miss. Unfortunately, he didn't.
column2: 你站在開闊處與班恩斯交火。你的緊張讓你失手了。很不幸，他沒有。

column1: The firefight between you and Bains ends with him winning. Remember, the one with the quick gun AND enough ammo wins.
column2: 你和班恩斯的槍戰以他獲勝告終。記住，拔槍快而且彈藥充足的人才會贏。

column1: The barrage is over. Bains lies motionless on the control room floor.
column2: 槍聲停了。班恩斯一動不動地躺在控制室地板上。

column1: It appears that all the firing range practice has paid off.
column2: 看來射擊場的所有訓練都派上用場了。

column1: Checking Bains, you find all vital signs have ceased.
column2: 你檢查班恩斯，發現他的生命跡象都已停止。

column1: You view Bains in his deceased state. Deep down inside, you kind of feel sorry for him. The reality, however, is that....
column2: 你看著已死的班恩斯。內心深處，你有點同情他。然而事實是……

column1: the destructive vengeance of "The Death Angel" has been silenced.
column2: 「死亡天使」那股破壞性的復仇已經沉寂。

column1: Oh Sonny! Marie says..."You're my hero! I don't want to leave you ever again!"
column2: 「喔，桑尼！」瑪麗說道……「你是我的英雄！我再也不想離開你了！」

column1: You don't have any extra ammo clips.
column2: 你沒有多餘的彈匣。

column1: Checking your gun, you see that the clip is not yet empty, and you do not reload.
column2: 你檢查手槍，發現彈匣還沒空，所以沒有重新裝填。

column1: Loaded.
column2: 已上膛。

column1: You do not have the field kit.
column2: 你沒有現場勘查箱。

column1: Your Detective's Field Kit is used to carry various things you will need in the course of your investigations: Plastic Baggie Small Camera Casting Plaster Glass Vial Eye Dropper Fingerprint Powder Fingerprint Brush Fingerprint Tape
column2: 你的警探現場勘查箱用來攜帶調查過程中所需的各種物品：塑膠證物袋、小型相機、石膏粉、玻璃小瓶、滴管、指紋粉、指紋刷、指紋膠帶。

column1: Hair, dirt, and other items can be placed in the plastic evidence bag.
column2: 頭髮、泥土和其他物品可以放入塑膠證物袋。

column1: The camera is used to preserve crime scenes on film for later analysis.
column2: 相機用來將犯罪現場拍攝在底片上，以便日後分析。

column1: Casting plaster can be used to make casts of foot prints.
column2: 石膏粉可以用來製作腳印模型。

column1: The glass vial is used to hold small samples of blood and other liquids.
column2: 玻璃小瓶用來裝少量血液和其他液體樣本。

column1: The eye dropper sucks up the liquid which is to be placed in the vial.
column2: 滴管用來吸取要放入小瓶的液體。

column1: Fingerprints leave oily residue. The powder clings to this residue.
column2: 指紋會留下油脂殘留物。粉末會附著在這些殘留物上。

column1: The brush is used to dust away excess fingerprint powder.
column2: 刷子用來刷掉多餘的指紋粉。

column1: Once a good fingerprint is found, the tape is used to pick it up and transfer it to a fingerprint card.
column2: 找到清晰指紋後，使用膠帶將它提取下來，轉貼到指紋卡上。

column1: Carefully, you apply the fingerprint powder and ... "Not worth processing" you think.
column2: 你仔細撒上指紋粉……你心想：「不值得送驗。」

column1: Click! You take a picture, and return the camera to your field kit.
column2: 「喀！」你拍下一張照片，將相機放回現場勘查箱。

column1: The fingerprint tape is used only after finding a useful print. By picking up the print with the tape, it can be transferred to a card.
column2: 指紋膠帶只能在找到有用指紋後使用。用膠帶提取指紋，就能將它轉貼到卡片上。

column1: There's nothing here worth the trouble.
column2: 這裡沒有值得費工的東西。

column1: You see nothing worth wasting casting plaster on.
column2: 你沒看到任何值得浪費石膏粉的東西。

column1: The compartments above the seats are for storing carry-on luggage, but since you have none, you do not need to bother with them.
column2: 座位上方的置物櫃用來存放手提行李，但你沒有行李，不必費心查看。

column1: The cockpit door is locked. Access is for crew members only.
column2: 駕駛艙門鎖著。只有機組人員可以進入。

column1: It's empty. Just go in.
column2: 裡面是空的。直接進去吧。

column1: You knock, but no one answers.
column2: 你敲門，但沒人回答。

column1: You can't.
column2: 你不能那樣做。

column1: Leave the door alone.
column2: 別管那扇門。

column1: This is my seat, and I ain't moving! growls the passenger.
column2: 乘客咆哮道：「這是我的座位，我才不走！」

column1: Find your seat, would you fella?
column2: 「先生，請找你的座位，好嗎？」

column1: In a rude tone of voice the passenger says... "Would you kindly sit down and quit asking questions."
column2: 乘客用粗魯的語氣說道……「請你坐下，別再問問題了。」
